scripts.test:backend: uv run --project packages/backend pytest -c packages/backend/pyproject.toml packages/backend/tests
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project packages/backend alembic -c packages/backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: uv run --project packages/backend alembic -c packages/backend/alembic.ini revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:status: uv run --project packages/backend alembic -c packages/backend/alembic.ini current
